review_findings.summary: Migration Validation job (now also runs the tenant-isolation integration test) is NOT in main's required status checks — advisory only, a broken migration or failing RLS test can merge.
migration-check.yml only triggers on supabase/** paths; a PR touching packages/database's integration test never runs it.
CI installs supabase CLI 'latest' while packages/database is lockfile-pinned to 2.111.0 — can silently drift.
.env.example key-reconciliation follow-up (real supabase status -o env, new sb_publishable_/sb_secret_ key format) only exists in a merged PR body, not tracked anywhere durable.
Docs/seed comments still reference the dropped example_tenants tables instead of #4's real migration.
ci.yml/migration-check.yml headers still describe pre-merge state.
Migration naming convention documented only in deployment-strategy.md, not in .claude/rules/database-migrations.md.

residual_risks: Tenant-isolation enforcement for this gate depends on humans reading a non-required check until finding 1 is fixed.
supabase/config.toml local-grade auth settings (short min password length, signup enabled) must not be carried to a real project.
required_actions: Add 'Migration Validation' to main's required status checks.
Extend migration-check.yml path filters to packages/database/** and lockfile.
Pin CI Supabase CLI version to match the lockfile.
Persist the .env.example reconciliation follow-up in docs/decisions/assumptions.md and document new-style key vars.
Fix stale docs/workflow references; add migration naming convention to .claude/rules/database-migrations.md.
